scorecard.note: Add verifiable sources for the shoe size increase and overweight statistics, and design clear, phone‑friendly graphics that directly illustrate the data.

storyboard.ears: Your feet are changing shape, and your waistline is a big part of why.
In the 1970s, the average British man wore a size 8 shoe. Now his feet have grown two full sizes.
storyboard.eyes: substance: the shoe's leather length; cause: Data grips the gauge's slider and drags it out two sizes, the shoe growing to fill it
storyboard.evidence: The College of Podiatry (UK) | Average UK men's shoe size, 1970s vs today | https://www.buckbootz.com/news/british-feet-get-two-sizes-bigger-in-40-years | 2026-11-06

storyboard.ears: It's not just length. About two in three women say their feet got wider as adults.
storyboard.evidence: The College of Podiatry (UK) | Share of UK adults who say their feet widened in adulthood | https://www.buckbootz.com/news/british-feet-get-two-sizes-bigger-in-40-years | 2026-11-06

storyboard.ears: Podiatrists blame body size. Two in three adults in England are overweight, and extra weight spreads the foot.
storyboard.evidence: NHS England | Share of adults in England overweight or living with obesity (2024) | https://nhsd-proxy.openprescribing.net/data-and-information/publications/statistical/health-survey-for-england/2021/overweight-and-obesity-in-adults | 2026-11-06

storyboard.ears: Your shoes aren't shrinking. You're outgrowing them, so check your size before you buy.
